text:
MetLife Stadium daa April 10, 2010 sɛ New Meadowlands Stadium, na ɛhyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ Meadowlands Sports Complex mu, faa Giants Stadium a ɛwɔ hɔ fi 1976 kosi 2010 no ananmu. Wɔde sika bɛyɛ US$1.6 billion bɔɔ no, na New York Giants ne New York Jets ownership na wɔde wɔn sika boaa ho, na ɛyɛ stadium a ɛyɛ expensive sen biara wɔ United States mu wɔ ɛberɛ a wɔwieeɛ no. Afe a ɛdi hɔ no, naming-rights agreement sesaeɛ ne din: wɔde 25-year deal a wɔde kyerɛw wɔ August 23, 2011 no, New Meadowlands Stadium bɛyɛɛ MetLife Stadium.

Wɔyɛɛ beaeɛ no sɛ fie a wɔde kyɛ NFL franchises mmienu, Giants ne Jets — nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ unusual a ɛda adi wɔ ne nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Lead architect no ne 360 Architecture, na wɔne EwingCole, Rockwell Group ne Bruce Mau Design yɛɛ adwuma, na building no exterior a ɛyɛ neutral no, wɔde home team biara ne nneɛma hyerɛn mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ club a ɛrebɔ no dea. Ownership no trɛ wɔ New Jersey Sports and Exposition Authority lineage mu.

Efi mfiase no, wɔbɔɔ MetLife sɛ ɛbɛgye nneɛma a ɛyɛ grandest scale, na ne milestones no trɛ codes mu. Wɔ American football mu no, wɔgyee Super Bowl XLVIII wɔ February 2, 2014, faa Seattle dii Denver 43–8 nkunimdie — Super Bowl a ɛyɛ cold-weather, open-air a edi kan, na kickoff temperatures bɛyɛ 49°F. Wɔ international football mu no, wɔgyee 2016 Copa América Centenario final, faa Chile dii Argentina 4–2 wɔ penalties so.

Ne beaeɛ wɔ global game no mu hyɛn wɔ 2026 World Cup no mu. FIFA paw stadium no sɛ ɛbɛgye tournament final no wɔ July 19, 2026, na ɛbɛgye nneɛma awotwe wɔ mu nyinaa. Sɛnea ɛbɛtumi agye event no ho hia no, wɔsesaeɛ playing surface no fi artificial turf kɔ natural Bermudagrass — nsesaeɛ a ɛdan gridiron venue a wɔyɛɛ no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ stage a ɛfata wiase no agoprama kɛseɛ no mu.
